name: labs/deepmodeling__uni-lab-os
title: Runze syringe pump
intro: Runze syringe pump, adapted from deepmodeling/uni-lab-os. It reads `plunger_position`, `velocity_grade`, `velocity_init`, `velocity_end` and 7 more; sets `position` and `max_velocity`; runs `pump` and `stop_pump`. `pump`: run a pump at a declared flow rate for a declared duration or volume in a declared direction, reporting the volume moved. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
